title: engine copy: six user-facing strings in objectql, metadata-protocol and platform-objects still say "authored in this environment" — the domain:engine half of #24327 (cloud#3002 ruling A)
body:
Carries the six `domain:engine` strings of #24327; #24327 keeps the six in `packages/runtime`.

**Filing gate ①, class (a): user-visible copy that contradicts a ruling,** split off by rule from #24327 (triage `6250167038`: "The dispatching seat either carries them under the cross-domain exception for a copy-only edit, or cuts a `domain:engine` card for them"). **Filed by** the `domain:cli` seat 1 (#6024) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01SYEJqDL3NXxrJRBVqaMu9T`. ⛔ Not a claim. The lane named by triage is `domain:engine`; the grade is triage's.

**Why a split rather than a carry:** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` is held by an in-flight claim (#23561, `domain:spec`, its `duplicatePackage` region). The engine lane sequences these three sites against it; the runtime six do not wait.

## The rule

objectstack-ai/cloud#3002 ruling A, as triage applied it to #24327: inside the running system, a user-facing string names the system the user is in as "this system", or drops the noun. A string that means "made here, not from a package" reads "authored in this system".

## The six sites (triage's per-string reading, `6250167038`; lines re-read on `origin/main` `e4bcced0b`, they move)

| site | text today | reading |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/objectql/src/default-record-page.ts` (about `:163`) | `page "…", authored in this environment` | "authored in this system" |
| `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (about `:1143`) | "… is authored in this environment (ADR-0010 §3.5) …" | "authored in this system" |
| `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (about `:1247`) | "an item saved here is authored in this environment …" | "authored in this system" |
| `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (triage's `:22110` on `1ef0ee89d`; the line moved, re-locate it) | holder text reaching a refusal | "authored in this system" |
| `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-metadata-activation.object.ts` (about `:151`) | field description: "… an item authored in this environment." | "authored in this system" |
| `packages/objectql/src/security-catalog-namespace.ts` (about `:212`) | `'the environment catalog (an item authored in this environment, not shipped by a package)'` | the parenthesis follows row 1. "the environment catalog" stays only if it is the documented name of that namespace; otherwise "this system's own catalog" |

- Tests and conformance fixtures that pin these strings move with them. Pin the kind or code, not the prose, unless a consumer parses the text (triage).
- A published page that quotes one of these strings as printed output is fixed in the same PR.
- The other non-test hits of `this environment` (about 122) are comments and are not this card's (triage).

## Done when

- The six strings read as above, and no test pins the old prose.

## Dedupe

- #24327 is the parent; triage `6250167038` found the cloud#3002 inventory (`6247161029`) puts the platform's runtime copy out of its scope. No other card covers these sites.

Dedupe words: authored in this environment engine copy; cloud#3002 ruling A server copy objectql metadata-protocol platform-objects.
